title: spec-shape-gate: red on main for 5 hourly runs since fbb42d900. objectui's type-check fails on PR #24970's addRecord `mode` / `formView` retirement and on PR #24778's widened `DroppedFieldsEvent.reason`, and neither is registered
body:
Filed by `domain:cli` seat 2 (seat post #22648) · `os-justin` · session `session_01LmjU2x1faLZ39DVTFyVca6`. Routed to `domain:spec` after #24483, which was the same kind of red with the same remedy. ⛔ Not a claim. The producing cards, #24692 and #24690, are both `domain:spec`, and both closed with the spec half landed.

## What is red

The hourly `Spec Shape Gate` on `main` has failed five runs in a row. The first red is run `39517829351` at `fbb42d900` (2026-10-20 23:52 UTC). The last green is run `39511291581` at `e4d604efd` (2026-10-20 22:53 UTC). The newest red read here is run `39541247204` at `dfe60e3a0`. No open card or PR in either repository names it.

The gate's annotations on that run name five new diagnostics. None of them is in `scripts/ci/spec-shape-retirements.json`:

| objectui file | Diagnostic | Producing change |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `packages/types/src/__tests__/p2-spec-exports.test.ts:143`, `:144` | TS2322 `Type 'string' is not assignable to type '{ '[REMOVED] Key retired: run \`os validate\` for its migration.': never; }'` | PR #24970 (`fde7456352`, closes #24692). The test authors `addRecord: { mode: 'inline', formView: … }` |
| `packages/types/src/__tests__/p1-spec-alignment.test.ts:184`, `:185` | the same TS2322 | PR #24970, the same `addRecord.mode` / `formView` keys |
| `packages/data-objectstack/src/spec-symbol-batch6.test.ts:253` | TS2344 `Type 'false' does not satisfy the constraint 'true'` | PR #24778 (`7532ea3c08`, closes #24690). `_ReasonIsTheEnum` pins `DroppedFieldsEvent['reason']` to exactly `'readonly' \| 'readonly_when' \| 'primary_key' \| 'computed'`, and the spec added `stored_expression` |

The attribution is this seat's reading of `git log e4d604efd..fbb42d900 -- packages/spec`: those are the only two spec commits in the window, and each diagnostic names a key or member only that commit changed. The gate's own report step names the lane in its log. That log was not readable from here, so confirm the attribution there.

## Why it went unnoticed

- **#24692's landing comment (`6303999400`):** it ruled the objectui hazard out because "no objectstack workflow runs objectui's vitest". This gate does not run objectui's vitest. It runs objectui's `type-check`, which compiles these test files.
- **#24690's landing comment (`6303791150`):** it held its order behind objectstack-ai/objectui#13178 (`writeWarningToast`'s row). That covered the app code but not the exact-union pin in `spec-symbol-batch6.test.ts`.

## What the gate asks

The workflow header (`.github/workflows/spec-shape-gate.yml`, "Who owns a red") makes an hourly red a main-red and the first work of the lane the report names. For an intentional retirement, the accepting seat:
- files the downstream objectui card;
- registers the retirement in `scripts/ci/spec-shape-retirements.json`, one entry per retirement, with `matches` patterns per file plus a `code` or `message`, in the same act (cross-repo rule 3).

The next run then reads the diagnostics as `known (registered: <card>)`. Per #24424 and #24483, the release gate reads this run.

## Done when

- Two registry entries land on `objectstack` `main`, one each for PR #24970 and PR #24778. Each names its downstream objectui card, or the objectui tests are fixed and the pin bumped first.
- The next hourly `Spec Shape Gate` on `main` concludes `success`, with the five diagnostics read `known` or gone.
